text:
Proposed adapter: preserve tensor-valued `log2feats(sequence)` by returning concatenated per-position features `[h_t, r_t]` of shape B×L×2D. Here `h_t` is the causal transformer state; `r_t` averages item embeddings over positions `max(0,t−K+1)…t`, excluding padding. Compute window sums and valid counts with prefix-sum differences; divide by `count.clamp_min(1)`. Count repeated items once per occurrence. `predict_score(features, items)` splits the features and applies the deployed scoring formula, for example `h_t·e_i + α r_t·e_i`. Route deployed inference through this same scorer. SASRec’s reference implementation scores item embeddings against sequence states and selects the final position for inference. [Reference implementation](https://github.com/kang205/SASRec/blob/master/model.py)

For left padding, use `sequence != 0` explicitly when summing embeddings and counting observations; do not rely solely on embedding row zero. Combine causal attention masking with padding-key masking, and zero padded output features. Prevent fully masked attention rows—for padded queries, permit a harmless dummy/self key before discarding their outputs—so NaNs cannot propagate. In PyTorch `MultiheadAttention`, Boolean mask `True` means blocked. If inference uses cosine scores, apply identical normalization to both branches and candidates with `F.normalize(..., dim=-1, eps=...)`; zero vectors then remain finite. [Attention masks](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.MultiheadAttention.html), [Normalization](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.functional.normalize.html)

Tests: under `eval()` and `no_grad()`, compare adapter final-position candidate scores with the loaded deployed predictor, including repeated candidates, repeated history items, short histories, all-padding inputs, and zero embeddings. Assert finite outputs and numerical closeness. For leakage, modify only tokens after position t while preserving tensor length and positional indices; features and candidate scores through t must remain unchanged. Check rolling averages against a simple loop oracle.
